fixed_reference_identity.rule: The owner must bind the actual C5 reference set. Clear prior original-reference inspection may be cited when the identity is unchanged; do not falsely claim a new view. Fresh workers still open any comparison image needed to judge a new case.

budget.worker_context: New fork_turns=none worker for every bounded job; no old C4 pixel-verdict inheritance.
budget.overflow_rule: Do not add a fifth pair or exceed eight image opens in one worker. If justified slots need additional images, make a separate fresh bounded job within the parent concurrency and overall candidate ceiling.

workflow: The capture owner maps these intent slots to actual real C5 recipes/IDs before the review begins; slot labels are not invented manifest IDs.
Root/FVD may omit a redundant already-clear comparison image; no repeated view is required merely to create activity.
Each worker reads frozen scope/plan and its small exact hash-bound input, then actually opens every assigned new original candidate and needed original reference.

Record actual viewing, case-specific observations and original/source/state/action/reference SHA in compact English JSON. Do not duplicate entire input manifests, full state/oracle dumps or base64 image data into reports.
Separate static appearance, existing captured behavior evidence, new action proof and native/performance external scopes.

If small text is unreadable, request an owner-generated original-scale crop with source/output SHA, dimensions, ROI, scale/algorithm and command/owner. Do not generate images or run programs locally, and do not invent a pass.
No production, harness, plan or raw capture edits by review workers; no local/remote tests/build/probes/SQL/SSH/hash calculations/image processing or new worker spawning.
A bounded failure returns the concrete current case/hash/observation to Root. Do not reopen unrelated historical repairs or add feature wishes.
no_product_change_contracts: G01 missing-clock observation is withdrawn as a first-pass visual error; original report and correction remain.
Toast follows authoritative HANDOFF section4.6 and is not redesigned solely for static caption overlap.
Truthful unavailable/fixed-on controls remain valid without inventing features.
Odd-final span1 is valid and must not be forced into a half-slot.
Demo mark-read projection inconsistency remains a raw evidence gap, not an instruction to force unread zero.

priorities: Actual migration match/disabled action and empty-history next action
Closed Reader pure scene or actual-state orientation semantics
root_spotcheck_request.rule: Send Root only two to four small exact path/hash packets, never whole-round images. Do not label a related or before/after image as an exact design reference.

next_full_round_gate.required_scope: All101 reference captures plus all21 supplemental groups and actual newly implemented capability/action evidence; all required fresh original cases actually viewed. Native/performance/lease evidence stays separately source/hash-bound.
next_full_round_gate.no_history_credit: Completed C4 historical checks are diagnostic closure evidence and never a new full-round capture or clean credit.
next_full_round_gate.review_dispatch: Use fresh fork-none bounded-size workers under the eight-viewer cap, preserving native/performance slots and all remote quiet windows.

model_routing: Inspect the currently advertised supported models and capability descriptions at dispatch time. If the metadata is insufficient to distinguish capabilities, intentionally inherit the parent model. Never hardcode a model based only on its name.
root_budget_refinement: Root explicitly limits each reference-paired worker to at most four pairs/eight opened images. Supplemental states without an independent exact reference may use up to eight actual images. Fresh jobs remain under the eight-concurrent-viewer cap.
